sophie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — vendor auth + model-registry outage. Need owners, short deadlines, and recurrence detection.

raj: I will own the auth rotation and reissue/backfill. Spike this week behind a feature flag.

maria: I'll take model-registry resiliency: durable webhook buffer + DLQ + idempotency. Target PR 2026-04-10.

jordan: I'll run routing fallback tests and reserve warm pool capacity; confirm routing-only dry-run.

elaine: I'll update the tracker, add acceptance criteria, and schedule weekly pings.

ops-bot: Created INC-4802 (raj) auth-rotation, INC-4803 (maria) webhook-buffer.

sophie: Acceptance criteria (add to tracker): auth canary 5xx <= 0.1% over 48h, webhook success >= 99.9% on 95th replay, routing test <1% error delta.

raj: Spike checklist: staging flag, 3% canary, dashboard for auth_5xx, webhook_5xx, fallback_rate. Demo by +5d.

maria: Will add synthetic replay tests to CI and surface dedupe metrics.

elaine: Auto-assign to oncall after 72h if owner unavailable. Add "recurring-pattern" label if same vendor outage occurs 3x in 90d.

sophie: Good. Action summary: INC-4802 (raj) auth spike + rollout plan; INC-4803 (maria) webhook buffer + DLQ. Reconvene in 14 days for status.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 14 days (thread pinned).
